items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Les, I can't remember Les' last name but there was a trumpet player and he played the English horn by the name of Sam Utterback.

ctx.x: Well, I mean who else was in that, Joe?
